description: Prepare an exit now from a partner vault, for a holder whose balance is more than the vault can pay now: the wallet's vault shares (amount, raw in the vault's asset at today's share value; the whole balance when omitted) are committed at the chain's exit desk, approved to it for exactly those shares, and the desk lists one of the vault's loans: first the one whose price can fall furthest for this exit, then the smallest that covers what the vault cannot pay of them. Over ten minutes its price falls from book value plus 99% of what the loan has still to earn: only the part the vault cannot pay can reach book value, and the price falls no further than the wallet's own share of that loan can pay, since the wallet pays the buyer's discount, so the listing may not sell. The sale pays the wallet at today's share value in its own transaction, to collect with earn_exit_collect; the request lasts 24 hours. Refused while the vault can pay the amount now (withdraw it with earn_redeem), beside an exit already open, or while exits are closed. Like a withdrawal, it avoids losses on loans that default after the wallet leaves; the holders who stay bear them. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

amount.description: What to exit, raw units of the vault's asset (USDG: 6 decimals) at today's share value; the whole balance when omitted

vault.description: A partner vault, as gage_earn_vaults lists it

wallet.description: The wallet that holds the vault's shares
